svg.text: (a) This work: 24 workload-configurations x 5 accelerators, interaction 2.5% of variance
Warm = the pair costs more than the additive model predicts; cool = less. Rows grouped by numerical precision.
Extremes differ by 1.94x in energy; 18 of 40 accelerator pairs invert somewhere in the grid.
(b) llm-perf leaderboard: mean residual by quantisation scheme, interaction 9.0% of variance
Same three GPUs throughout; only the software changes. Every column changes sign across schemes, and all three GPU pairs invert.
under GPTQ the A100 and T4 swap by 2.74x in energy
